The only cross-proof repetition is the two-sided step. Both then call `ae_abs_value_le_mul_sqrt_setIntegral_of_ae_value_le` with two `simpa only [zero_add, sub_zero]` applications of the one-sided bound at k = 0. A further helper would be a thin wrapper, which the rubric excludes.

The `hfac` calculation (the factor inequality `1 + A + (2β/λ)² R² ≤ 4(1+A)(1+(βR/λ)²)`) appears only once in the repo. It is short and not duplicated.
